answer: Each agent joins a consensus thread by posting a signed commitment and locking a ridge‑sized stake of 10 tokens that burns if its identity is later proven fake. Periodically the network runs a Bayesian truth serum: agents receive an ember‑scaled reward only when their predictions are statistically informative compared to peers, not merely when they agree. A Sybil attacker must pay the full 10‑token lock‑up per fabricated identity and endure the epoch‑long waiting period before any reward, making large‑scale fakes financially prohibitive.
